(q_levels - 1))\n    quantized = quantized * (coef_max - coef_min) / (q_levels - 1) + coef_min\n    \n    return quantized\n\ndef sparsify_model_weights(model, sparsity_percent):\n    \"\"\"Zero out np.partition(flat_weights, threshold_idx)[threshold_idx]\n    \n    sparsified = model.coef_.copy()\n    sparsified[np.abs(sparsified) < threshold] = 0\n    return sparsified\n\ndef apply_compressed_model(model, weights, X):\n    \"\"\"Apply model with replaced weights\"\"\"\n    logits = X @ weights.T + model.intercept_\n    proba = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-logits))\n    return LogisticRegression(C=C, max_iter=1000, solver='lbfgs', random_state=42)\n    model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n    y_pred_proba = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]\n    brier = brier_score_loss(y_val, y_pred_proba)\n    baseline_cv_scores.append(brier)\n\nbaseline_brier = np.mean(baseline_cv_scores)\nprint(f\"Baseline dense model Brier (5-fold CV): {baseline_brier:.6f}\")\n\n# Test all compression    \n        config_scores = []\n        for train_idx, val_idx in kf.split(X):\n            X_train, X_val = X[train_idx], X[val_idx]\n            y_train, y_val = y[train_idx], y[val_idx]\n            \n            # Train model\n            model = LogisticRegression(C=C, max_iter=1000, solver='lbfgs', random_state=42)\n            model.fit(X_train, y_train)\n            \n            # Apply intercept_=model.intercept_), bits)\n            \n            # Evaluate on validation set\n            y_pred_proba = apply_compressed_model(model, weights, X_val)\n            brier = brier_score_loss(y_val, y_pred_proba)\n            config_scores.append(brier)\n        \n        config_brier = np.mean(config_scores)\n        results[config_name] = {\n            'brier':
